exposure: Specific life-limiting fetal conditions categories (e.g., aneuploidy, amniotic fluid anomalies)
cohort: Pregnant individuals with life-limiting fetal conditions managed expectantly in a UK tertiary Fetal Medicine Unit, compared to controls delivering structurally normal, singleton infants.
finding: Life-limiting fetal conditions pregnancies carry higher risks of preterm birth, particularly with amniotic fluid abnormalities, and hypertension is more common in aneuploidy cases, compared to controls.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections occurred in 13.6% of expectantly managed pregnancies with life-limiting fetal conditions.
